records.determination: One corridor across staged openings. The station inventory avoids an inaccurate all-underground-stations inference. Parliamentary cost and status rows remain line-specific. App launch and accessible design do not establish transaction success, fare integration or sustained reliability.

One line, not separate financing tranches. The historical loan schedule is not completion. The non-peer-reviewed road paper retains its June 2024 endpoint and local corridor scope; the separate household findings are attributed only to a conference account. Failed DMTCL retrieval does not establish extension non-completion.

One municipal area, not the whole metropolitan region. The 2019 inventory stays historical. Climate budget instructions and electrification targets are not observed expenditure, accepted vehicles or delivered service. Regional app participation does not extend the municipality's boundary.

Each article contains six substantive sections, a sourced chronology, a defined identity and three concrete next artifacts. Limitations accompany the affected findings rather than appearing only in a general disclaimer.

Historical portfolio and project registries, prior reviewed cohorts, all 34 readings and the Phase 60 ledger remain unchanged. This is AI author self-review, not independent review or external release acceptance.
